content.text:
**My answer:** I'd open an account at פסגות and buy the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)", then put in a set amount every month. I'm fairly sure. What decided it: with ת"א-125 picked, the page puts that pair on top and marks it "הבחירה שלכם · הזול ★". It says 86,045 ₪ is left after 10 years, and the next best option is 1,030 ₪ less. פסגות is a name I know, so that was fine. The first thing I'd do is open the פסגות account.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **Top of the page.** The heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן" is exactly what I came for. The ת"א-125 button was already chosen.
- **The sliders.** They were at 10,000 ₪ today, 500 a month, 10 years and 7%. I didn't move them to my 30,000, so all the numbers are for 10,000.
- **The big numbers.** "70,000 ₪" deposited, then "86,045 ₪" for the cheapest choice and "85,015 ₪" for the runner-up. The 70,000 is what stuck with me.
- **The cost bar.** "כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים" says 7,323 ₪. That's a lot. The big pink chunk is 5,555. I guessed it was fees. Later I caught "מס" at the far left of the legend, so maybe it's tax. I'm not sure.
- **The two boxes.** פסגות on one side, the fund list on the other with "דמי ניהול 0.1%". The bank list goes פסגות, לאומי, מיטב דש... sorry, מיטב טרייד sits much lower. I scrolled past most of it. I saw the bottom ones (אלטשולר טרייד, אקסלנס, מיטב טרייד) lose about 20,000.
- **The rest.** The "מה הכי משנה" chart and the step-by-step bars at the end I skimmed only.

**Where I got stuck:**
- The numbers with a minus sign: "−1,030 ₪", "−0.04%", "−1,733". At first I read them as losses. Even the recommended fund shows "−0.04%".
- The step chart further down starts at "עכשיו: הראל סל... ירושלים 79,910". I never picked ירושלים, so I got lost there and stopped.
- I'm not sure if the "מחקה" fund I'm buying is the same kind of thing as the "סל" ones.

**Words I didn't get:** דמי משמרת, צוברת, "4A", "מול המדד", "העמלות זו על זו", "סטיית" (not shown, but "מול המדד" felt like that).
